notes.title: Broken: Paranormal investigation update 1.17
notes.content:
Here is the list of changes:

- Added the possibility to create public servers. Any player can then join your game.
- Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when leaving the game from the car.
- Update of the discord address on the home screen.
- Adding translation

notes.title: Quick fix on the tutorial - version 1.161
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the tutorial introduced in the last update.

Thanks Darki for reporting it!

notes.title: Updated on version 1.16 - Guidance during a game
notes.content:
Add:

- added interactive help. When you press the help key, a window to guide you in solving the enigma appears.
- added key configuration in options
- added translation

Fix
- fixed a bug that did not display the right key to configure in the options
- slight performance optimization

notes.title: Broken: Paranormal investigation update 1.15
notes.content:
- The breathless sound now only plays once per minute maximum.
- Fixed a bug that could make a ghost player cross the ground in the graveyard map

notes.title: Halloween update - Broken : paranormal investigation
notes.content:
Change:
When loading a map, the sound starts in a softer way

Fix:
Fixed a bug that could cut the ambience background sound

notes.title: New map and enigma for halloween !
notes.content:
New content is coming for Halloween! Enjoy a unique puzzle to solve during Halloween week, there is a reward ;)

Added:
- New map: Graveyard
- New puzzle specific to the map graveyard
- New achievement for those who manage to solve the special Halloween enigma in the time allowed!

Change in the map: 
- Bones have been replaced by skulls for the puzzle Destruction 1
- Special halloween decoration for the lobby

Correction: Bones have been replaced by skulls in the Destruction 1 puzzle:
- Some texts are now centered correctly
- Some buttons are now correctly managed by the "ui" mixer
- Correction of the translation of the wave detector which could be replaced by "incense stick".
- Fixed a bug that could prevent the connection to a multiplayer game

notes.title: Quickfix 21/10/2022
notes.content: Fixed a bug on the text bubble of items.

notes.title: Version 1.13 - Updated on 21/10/2022 - Broken : paranormal investigation
notes.content:
Improvement:
- Increased the size of ghostly orbs to make them more visible
- Improved the uv lamp, the display of fingerprints and blood traces works better

Correction:
- Fixed a bug that could move doors and drawers when using "pose mode"

Added:
- Added an arachnophobic mode in settings. Spiders are replaced by rats.

notes.title: Broken : Paranormal investigation
notes.content:
[h2]Change[/h2]
class: medium can now see which torches are used to open a secret passage
class: a2000 can now detect all types of paranormal activity
interface: the name of the object in use is now displayed
interface: the name of the object to be picked up is now displayed

[h2]Fix[/h2]
interface: fixed overlapping text in the lobby
interface: fixed overlapping text when using the a2000

a2000: fixed a bug that prevented the display from updating

localization: matteo's class is now displayed correctly

notes.title: Broken: Paranormal investigation - Updated on 11/10/2022
notes.content:
[h2]Change[/h2]

[b]Interface[/b] : The game host is now the only one who can change the map and the difficulty

[h2]Fix[/h2]

[b]Localization[/b] : Add translation and fix bug on glow stick translation
[b]Ghost[/b] : Fixed a bug that could trap the ghost when moving
[b]Interface[/b] : Fixed a bug that let appear a text bubble

notes.title: Updated on 09/10/2022
notes.content:
Added:

Lobby : a player can now be invited by a client and not only by the server

Fix:
Controls: fixed a bug that could affect the player's control when a controller was plugged in in addition to the keyboard and mouse

Animation: fixed a bug that could make the mace or bat animation play in a loop

Wave detector: fixed a bug that could block the scrolling of frequencies

Interface: the invitation button is now taken into account by the audio mix

notes.title: Updated on 08/10/2022
notes.content:
Change:
- Interface: there are no more duplicate maps
- Fingerprinting: fingerprints are now more visible
- Feature: lock-picking is back

Bug fix:
Results: the experience is now assigned to the right character on the client side
Game: fixed a bug that stopped the game after 1 death
Tutorial: fixed the display of the pickup

Others:
Optimization: minor graphical optimization during a game

notes.content:
Correction on the tutorial
Fixed a crash when trying to activate an item that was not in hand

notes.title: Updated game balance
notes.content:
Improved the tutorial. Many elements of the game have been added.
Fixed a bug on the home screen.


Improved the balancing of the game:
- the spirit of a single player drops less quickly
- a new player starts with 4000 $ instead of 2000
- when the investigation progresses enough, players receive a payment
- some enigmas are only accessible from a certain level of difficulty

Tutorial: Fixed a bug that could block the tutorial
